frames.fidelityNotes: The approved final Home design at 390x844, first in Screens on the Home page, and the production Home layout since #789. TotalBalanceCard 273:5644 uses Card variant=flush, inset=hero 301:5912. A lone FinanceRow value beside a two-line label is centred in Figma (proposed; code top-aligns it). Every Your money row (Cash, Investments, Borrow Cash) and every Activity row (six) is a single genericized FinanceRow instance (Layout=Title aligned) configured only through component properties, named semantically (Balance / …, Activity / …). Money-in Activity values (Received ×2, Borrowed) use Value tone=Success (color/market-gain); the rest use Default. Borrow Cash's value context reads 5.1% APR (Jesse decision on #789: loans quote APR, Cash stays APY). Rows are inset 32 px from the frame edge (16 px content + 16 px card padding), 326 px wide.

markAssets.note: Real, license-clean SVGs imported in place into the existing CurrencyMarkSlot variants (set 12:59, all variant IDs preserved). #789 adopted the same sources in production: Twemoji flags (CC-BY 4.0) in apps/web/public/currency-flags/ rendered inset in a neutral circle, cryptocurrency-icons USDC/BTC/ETH (CC0) in apps/web/public/asset-marks/, and lucide glyphs through GlyphMark; licenses and provenance are recorded beside each asset directory.
markAssets.shadcnCoverage: shadcn's default icon set is lucide (this repo already uses iconLibrary lucide with lucide-react). No single shadcn registry covers flags + fiat/crypto + stocks; the combination adopted in #789 is lucide (ISC) + Twemoji flags (CC-BY 4.0) + cryptocurrency-icons (CC0). Per-stock brand logos are trademark-encumbered and need a dedicated licensed source; the generic mark is the stock fallback for now.

residualDifferences: Home — final (92:922) is the production Home layout since #789; Home — funded (13:19), v1 (65:503), v2 (81:700), and the explorations are on the Archive page (333:13094) pending deletion (#841).

#789 changed the FinanceRow Value context default and every visible Borrow Cash value context from 5.1% APY to 5.1% APR in Home — final, FinanceRow — all variants (131:1285), and FinanceRow — usage reference (116:1154). Production formats rates with two decimals (5.10% APR, 4.20% APY) to match the Save and Borrow surfaces; Figma shows one decimal.

Production Activity values are token amounts (+25.00 USDC) and contexts are dates (Sep 22, 5:00 AM); Figma shows fiat values and 'Today · USDC'. Fiat Activity values need priced transfer data, which is new backend data and out of scope for #789.

Production loading rows render ShimmerRows (pulsing mark, no chevron); in #841 the Figma loading mark became a centred 40px circle to match code's CurrencyMark pending. ShimmerRow Show media and Show context remain proposed: code ShimmerRows accepts only count and always draws both lines and the mark.

Home has no red load-error UI. Balance read failures show a status icon in the header (HomeHeaderStatus) whose popover holds the message and a Retry icon button, or Open Account when no country is set. Activity read failures show a centered, muted line with a reload icon inside the Activity feed. The shared destructive Alert no longer renders on Home; the Activity page (/activity, density page) still uses it.

A failing summary row stays tappable (so Save, Invest, and Borrow remain reachable on a cold balances error) but hides its chevron until it has loaded, as Figma shows. A row whose value is known but partial (for example Borrow with partial coverage) renders its value in the muted tone and raises the same header status.
Home no longer links to the Balances (/balances) and Activity (/activity) panels; both stay reachable by URL. Removing or re-homing them is shell work for #686.

In a component set the text-property default is shared by every variant, so MoneyBreakdownItem definitions all read 'Cash', Button definitions both read 'Add money', and TabItem definitions both read 'Home'; every instance overrides the label. The variant grid differs by dot colour, fill, and icon.
The browser uses the system sans stack while Figma resolves SF Pro/Inter text styles; glyph metrics and rasterization differ slightly.
MoneyTicker and navigation transitions are static in Figma; Figma does not execute pagination, network, retry, focus, history, account switching, reduced motion, or wallet behavior.

Updating shared component definitions (marks, MoneyBreakdownItem borrow) also refreshes the superseded frames and the funded baseline, since they instance the same nodes; this is intended component behavior and does not change any frame structure. The FinanceRow Centered (legacy) variant preserves the funded baseline's amount alignment.
The rendered US flag mark uses twemoji artwork scaled uniformly; its intrinsic aspect is compact rather than a 1.9:1 physical flag, acceptable at the 32px mark scale.

Run 24 regrouped Home components (11:767) under seven category headings. #841 moved Screens (11:768) and Home states (190:2821) to the Home page and Archive (145:1638) to its pending-deletion page; it deleted no nodes. The #841 audit found zero overlapping sections per page, zero children outside their sections and zero overlapping children inside sections.

Borrow Cash's context copy was shortened to the Jesse-approved one-line 'Against your investments' in Home — final (113:1204) and the FinanceRow — usage reference (116:1179); it renders on one line at the 326 px Home row width. Superseded frames (v2 81:700, v1 65:503) retain their historical 'Borrow against your investments' copy.
